<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-20. -->
## YouTube – Icons ([#70](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/issues/70))

- **SponsorBlock:** Skip button duration, Skip toast duration, and Adjust new segment step now have icons in Regular (Thin), Bold, Bold (stock size), and YouTube styles when **Apply to all settings menu** is enabled.
- **Shorts:** The selected player icon style now applies to the regular watch player’s fullscreen exit button without replacing the stock artwork used for **Restore screen** in Shorts clear mode.

All four SponsorBlock icon styles were verified in patched YouTube 21.45.90 builds, and the YouTube-style rows and dialogs were checked on a Moto Edge Plus 2023. The stock Shorts artwork was verified in the patched APK; the live Restore screen button still needs confirmation.

Includes the fullscreen changes from v1.44.1-dev.1.
